facts.title: LMCache/LMCache Nightly 2026-08-05 · CUDA 13.0
facts.event_hint: LMCache publishes a 2026-08-05 nightly CUDA 13.0 wheel built from the dev branch
facts.problem: The nightly release provides an installable pre-release LMCache build for CUDA 13.0 users who need the latest dev-branch changes before a stable release.
facts.mechanism: The GitHub release publishes nightly CUDA 13.0 wheels built from dev on 2026-08-05 and directs users to install lmcache with uv pip --pre, the PyTorch cu130 extra index, and the nightly expanded-assets link.

evidence.claim: The nightly CUDA 13.0 wheels were built from dev on 2026-08-05.
The installation command uses uv pip install lmcache --pre with the cu130 extra index and nightly expanded assets.

facts.evaluation_context: This is an upstream LMCache GitHub nightly release page. The available text documents packaging and installation only; it contains no runtime benchmark, workload, hardware, latency, throughput, or cache-transfer measurements.
facts.limitations: This is a nightly dev build and may be unstable or incompatible with released APIs. The page does not describe the included code changes, dependency matrix, or performance impact; those require inspecting the repository or package separately.
facts.project_relevance: The nightly wheel may enable testing the latest LMCache changes on CUDA 13.0 infrastructure, but this release alone provides no evidence of improvements to KV-cache transfer or state-aware networking.
source_notes: The upstream GitHub nightly release URL was fetched and its release body was available despite page-loading warnings.
No functional or performance claims beyond the packaging information were inferred.
